people.name: Barend Jan Terwiel
people.field: anthropologist, historian and Thai studies scholar

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.evidence: He completed his studies at the Utrecht University with a candidaats degree in Cultural Anthropology in 1965

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.role: doctorandus degree in anthropology, Pali and the History of Buddhism
relations.evidence: and a doctorandus degree in anthropology, Pali and the History of Buddhism in 1967.

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.evidence: For his doctoral studies, he moved to the Australian National University where he graduated with a Ph.D. in 1972.

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.evidence: From 1972 to 1974, Terwiel worked as a coordinator training volunteers at the Dutch Royal Tropical Institute, Amsterdam.

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.object: Faculty of Asian Studies of the Australian National University
relations.evidence: Then, he became a lecturer at the Faculty of Asian Studies of the Australian National University in Canberra, where he was promoted to Senior Lecturer in 1982

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.evidence: promoted to Senior Lecturer in 1982 and Reader in Asian History in 1991.

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel

relations.evidence: In the same year, he was appointed Professor at the Institute of Ethnology of LMU Munich, Germany.

relations.subject: Barend Jan Terwiel
relations.object: Asia and Africa Institute of the University of Hamburg
relations.role: Chair of Languages and Cultures of Thailand and Laos
relations.evidence: In 1992, Terwiel moved to the Asia and Africa Institute of the University of Hamburg where he held the Chair of Languages and Cultures of Thailand and Laos until his retirement in 2007.
